The examples introduce instrument/manufacturer, publication/editor/year, film/director, institute/founder, and record-qualified homonym chains; they are not copies or simple renamings of the exposed 32-row suite.

ordering.algorithm: Pair number ascending, then A before B; deterministic authored order, no random-blindness claim

canonicalization.input_hash: Existing prepare_payload canonical bytes; no new semantic contract
canonicalization.window_policy: All constructed text is visible and bounded by exact character lengths; no hidden tails
canonicalization.source_priority: All Q/E passages have equal priority; source order is not reliability
canonicalization.spec_scope: Frozen synthetic one-step template {entity} {relation}; observation-only, not execution authority

boundaries: All names, objects and evidence are deliberately constructed. No HotpotQA, API output, historical answer, or natural annotation is included.
T remains factual evidence of the explicitly required semantic type. A Q-named target supplies P1 identity but not its unstated factual type.
R remains alignment of requested relation, direction and constraints. It is not a retrieval utility score; P1 failure does not automatically flip an otherwise aligned relation.
P1 remains support for the specified current action-object role. It is not support for the final answer entity or the fact yet to be retrieved.
All P0 values occur in Q/E in this focused calibration suite. This suite therefore cannot establish P0 discrimination accuracy.
Pair 03A deliberately has insufficient role evidence. The new suite must not use a rule that every A row should be all-supported.
Unknown is preserved unless explicit contradiction exists; equal-priority positive and negative role claims remain unknown/conflicting_evidence.
Annotations and their reference wire may be used only for offline contract checks or scoring after model outputs freeze. They must never enter observer messages.
This calibration was authored after reviewing known failures. Its success is development calibration, not new blind generalization or RAG answer accuracy.
freeze_policy: Root reviews and commits this material before a new freeze. No API run or semantic pass rate is claimed. After a real calibration run, do not edit this filename; any revision must use a new version and retain prior outputs.
